0x000A5B.en: 「With my skills as they are now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x000ACC.en: 「Ngh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000B54.en: 「Damn it!@　Next time you won't get me!」

0x000C7D.en: 「Is this as far as I go......!?」

0x000CB5.en: 「Oh dear...@　How uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000D7E.en: 「Tch! So this is where I fall...!」

0x000DB9.en: 「Getting wrecked in a place like this...@　What a joke...」

0x000E0D.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000E81.en: 「Guh! Nothing to do but fall back!!」

0x000EF7.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000F5E.en: 「This is the end for me... The rest is up to you.」

0x00100A.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... We're retreating!」

0x001057.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x001095.en: 「Kyaa! I leave the rest to you all!」

0x001187.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one falling like a meteor... Ejecting!」

0x001330.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001377.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0013AC.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x001498.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@　I'm still so green...!」

0x0014E6.en: 「No good, this is my limit! Retreating!」

0x00160E.en: 「Good grief, so this is the end.」

0x00163D.en: 「I'm afraid I can't manage any further. If you'll all excuse me.」

0x0016C8.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back here...!」

0x001745.en: 「Tch...! I couldn't hold out after all...!」

0x00182E.en: 「I'm ejecting...@　Ngh...! No way to save face...」

0x0018EC.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001C15.en: （Child of god, Irui...@　You who inherit my will...）

0x001CCB.en: 「I don't really remember, but@　I felt like someone was calling me...」

0x001D7B.en: 「A little... uneasy... but sort of nostalgic too...」

0x001DD4.en: 「Ibis...@　could this be a sign that@　Irui's memories are coming back...?」

0x001E7A.en: 「If my memories come back...@　won't I be able to stay with Ibis and everyone anymore...?」

0x001EEC.en: 「Once I find out where I came from...@　will I be torn away from everyone...?」

0x001F70.en: 「If that's how it is, then I... even if my memories never come back...」

0x001FE4.en: 「B-but... remembering the past@　just makes me so uneasy...」

0x00203A.en: 「...I think I understand how you feel.」

0x00208A.en: 「My situation's different from yours, Irui, but...@　I have no memories of my past either.」

0x0020E3.en: 「Not just Seolla... me and Lat too.」

0x002170.en: 「If my memories came back,@　maybe something would change...@　I had that same fear.」

0x002201.en: 「But because Arado and Lat and the others were there,@　I got through it somehow. The bonds with everyone@　were what held me up.」

0x0022D5.en: 「If our being here can hold you up...」

0x002312.en: 「It'd make me happy if you felt that way, Irui.」

0x002355.en: 「You're our precious friend, Irui...@　Even if you get your memories back, that won't change.」

0x002401.en: 「Yes, he reached us on the ether communicator.@　Ryusei and the others are talking with him now.@　Do you want to sit in?」

0x0024B3.en: 「I see...@　Things are one hell of a mess on your end.」

0x002506.en: 「Well, it's a rough spot, but...@　it's not like we're completely on our own.」

0x002568.en: 「But the Inspectors' allies are attacking too, right?」

0x0025B4.en: 「Maybe because we shut down their opening move, they're being oddly cautious.@　That said, the moon's slipping into their hands.」

0x002631.en: 「If the Federation doesn't launch a counterattack soon,@　they could seize total control of space.」

0x0026A2.en: 「We're worried about it too, but@　there's nothing we can do from where we stand.」

0x00270A.en: 「Sorry for calling at such a bad time...」

0x00274D.en: 「Nah, just knowing Martha and the rest are doing fine@　is enough to make me glad.」

0x0027E6.en: 「We're managing to settle down somehow.@　So, the main thing... the reason I called you@　is that there's something I want to ask.」

0x0028AA.en: 「Actually... we've stopped seeing Louzorl and@ his crew. Back in <La Gias> they were always up@ to something, but lately, nothing at all.」

0x0029A9.en: 「It should be, but it's eerie, if anything.」

0x0029E9.en: 「True... the chaos after the war@　would play right into their hands...」

0x002A42.en: 「Shu's whereabouts are still a mystery.@　So I got to thinking, maybe he's@　down on the surface somewhere.」

0x002ACC.en: 「For now, at least, there's no word@　of the Granzon showing up...」

0x002B38.en: 「Just to be safe, I'll ask Major Gilliam too.」

0x002B78.en: 「Thanks.@　And... give it a little while longer, and@　I'll head to the surface and link up with you.」

0x002BF9.en: 「Huh? You sure it's fine to leave Langran?」

0x002C30.en: 「You lot are going through hell out there.@　I can't just sit back. I'll leave things@　here to Lune, Yang Long and the rest.」

0x002CD5.en: 「It'd be a big help if you came, Masaki...@　but are you really okay with that?」

0x002D34.en: 「Yeah. Send me the data on where@　you're headed later, would you?」

0x002D93.en: 「Got it. Just don't get lost.@　...Not that saying so will do any good.」

0x002E1A.en: 「I'd like to help too, but...@　I've got a mountain of work to do,@　so it doesn't look like I can make it.」

0x002EA4.en: 「It's rough on everyone, I know... but hang in there.」

0x002F1F.en: 「I wondered why I'd been called in...@　so this is what it was about.」

0x00304B.en: 「There's something like self-repairing metal cells@　built into the frame.」

0x003187.en: 「So it wouldn't need maintenance for a long time,@　I'd say... And that medicine you're taking,@　it doesn't just suppress rejection...」

0x003294.en: 「Slow it down...?@　Then what happens to me if the medicine runs out?」

0x003346.en: 「And if that happens... it will kill you.」

0x00337D.en: （Damn it, Mitarl...!@　Putting a leash like this on me...!）

0x0033D3.en: 「That medicine contains components I can't identify...@　As things stand, it can only be made@　within the Zentr Project.」

0x003481.en: 「While you still have the medicine, I'll do all@　I can to find another way.」

0x0034DA.en: 「...Understood.@　I'm sorry, but I'll leave it to you.」

0x00352E.en: 「Intercepting Federation comms again!@　No mistake, they're engaging the Ruina@　on the east coast of Ecuador!」

0x003B43.en: 「That's right.@　I'd rather not be told I saw what was right@　and lacked the courage to do it.」

0x003BB5.en: 「If you'd prefer, you're OK to@　sit this one out, y'know.」

0x003D21.en: 「Well, we're short on hands ourselves anyway.」

0x003D61.en: 「...Assault 1 to all units. The other sectors worry me too.@　Let's wrap this up fast.」

0x003DEB.en: 「...This is taking too long.@　Assault 1 to all units. Formation A3.@　We crush the enemy dead ahead in one push.」

0x004033.en: 「Tch!@　Don't think you can stop me! Claymore!」

0x004091.en: 「Ah, it's useless.@　There are plenty more to replace them.@　But your ammunition is limited, isn't it?」

0x00413A.en: 「Last time, in the Boundary Realm, I tried to@　win you over as gently as I could...」

0x004199.en: 「But with you people,@　a more direct method seems more effective.」

0x00422E.en: 「Stay still a while.@　Not that the binding curse would let you move anyway.」

0x004373.en: 「The Byakko's pilot seems to be out cold.@　Honestly, the Sixiong don't know@　the meaning of restraint. It's a problem.」

0x004419.en: 「Yes, Chokijin ranked above the Four Gods...@　the Sixiong, ToTetsuOh and KyuKiOh.」

0x0044AE.en: 「Immensely powerful, but utterly vicious -@ the highest class of Yokijin. Though once@ Chokijin themselves, they defied the god Baral.」

0x004580.en: 「After a fierce battle, two of the Sixiong@ fell... collars were placed on ToTetsuOh@ and KyuKiOh once again, by my hand and Taihoku's.」

0x004622.en: 「But they have no need of strong-willed pilots like you.@　Do you know why?」

0x0046AC.en: 「Even a strong-willed one is too dangerous to put in the cockpit.@　They don't feed on a person's soul-force...」

0x004785.en: 「...Even among the Sixiong, ToTetsuOh is especially greedy.」

0x004815.en: 「Kusuha. If you truly worry about this star's@ future, join us. Don't let a moment's emotion@ make you lose sight of the greater ambition.」

0x004922.en: 「If you have such an ambition!@　Then make him stop this right now!@　Stop that Chokijin!!」

0x0049A6.en: 「I told you already.@　Their lives will not be spent in vain.」

0x0049FF.en: （It's the same as before... this is how Kanan breaks a heart.）

0x004AC2.en: 「I-I'll take his place!@　So, so please! Stop it!!」

0x004B27.en: 「Every life weighs the same... but each has a different meaning.@　The moment a life shines brightest differs for every one.」

0x004BBF.en: 「And the moment his life shines most nobly...@　is now.」

0x004C28.en: 「Rest in peace... all is upon the Tao.@　Nameless soldier... your soul, I will not treat lightly.」

0x004CBB.en: （When the heart breaks, the soul is taken captive...）

0x004D48.en: 「Kusuha... though you sink into grief's depths,@ your heart hasn't broken yet. Just like before...@ when you fought the Yokijin, Chujin.」

0x004E0F.en: 「Kusuha... you're a lone violet blooming in a steep valley.@ I'll pluck and cherish you, so your fleeting@ flower of a face may last forever.」

0x004ED0.en: 「Yes, break it... your heart, that is.」

0x004F01.en: 「Now, KoOhKi. Reclaim your other half.@　By devouring that life.」

0x0051BA.en: 「It broke, didn't it. Your heart.@　Heheh, your anguished scream... it feels wonderful.」

0x005213.en: (...Just like me...@ Back then, my father and mother were destroyed by Kanan and the others...)

0x005275.en: 「Now, Seiryu.@　Cast out the impurities the humans built into you,@　and return to your true form as well.」

0x0053DD.en: （I felt it too...!@　But that wasn't only Kusuha's psychic power...）

0x00545E.en: 「Everyone!@　Clean up the Ruina here fast, and@　let's head to where Kusuha is!」

0x005586.en: (I'm sorry... Bullet...@ everyone in the defense force... and RyuJinKi...)

0x0055F4.en: （Lieutenant Kyosuke... Ensign Excellen... everyone...@　I'm already...）

0x0056C5.en: （I-Irui...!?@　Wh-why can I hear your voice...@　and see you...!?）

0x00585C.en: （So they can protect this world... everyone...）

0x0059BA.en: （I want to help Kusuha and Bullet... everyone...@　That's my honest feeling... right now...）

0x005A65.en: （Just for a little while... I'll give you my power...）

0x005C06.en: 「But if we let them undergo shijie,@　they'll become the mightiest of blades.」

0x005CB9.en: 「That shark robot from before... and a new face!?」

0x00609E.en: 「Impossible, Seiryu can't do that in this state...!」

0x0069EC.en: 「I dropped by the Kurogane to fetch Soulgain.@　...That should get you moving. Consider it a loan.」

0x00A49C.en: 「You mentioned that before as well...@　What is this bond with Baral?」

0x00A501.en: 「An ancient text has been passed down in my house.@　It records that my ancestor became RyuKoOh's pilot@　and fought against the demons.」

0x00A60F.en: 「But only espers can pilot that thing,@　can't they...?」

0x00A668.en: 「Some of my ancestors had strong psychic power.@　Sadly, I don't have the gift myself...@　but I can carry on their will.」

0x00A70A.en: 「And so, with my pupils Bullet and Kusuha, and KoRyuOh@ and RyuKoOh at our side, I'll finally sever the bond@ between my Togo house and Baral.」

0x00A7CD.en: 「They've brought out these Four Fiends of theirs, too...@ If the Master and Axel are willing to help,@ that's more than welcome.」

0x00A869.en: 「Oh? You don't seem to think so?」

0x00A8BC.en: 「...The distortion in this world's framework troubles me.@　Partly because I myself came from another world.」

0x00A954.en: 「Could it be that the reason Axel and I came back@ to this side separately was...」

0x00A9C5.en: 「Exactly.@　There may be something in this world that warps the boundaries.@　I want to know what it is.」

0x00AA58.en: 「And besides... Duvan Org is on my mind too.」

0x00AA9E.en: （Could it be... because it ties back@　to Alfimi?）

0x00AAF4.en: 「So then, Captain...@　are we to take it that you'll be lending us@　a hand?」

0x00AB78.en: 「But there must be those here who bear a grudge against me.@　Both sides lost something, after all.」

0x00ABF5.en: 「Don't expect us to play nice, Kyosuke Nanbu.」

0x00AC4B.en: (Funny, since the two of them had their comebacks@ perfectly in sync just now...@ They might end up a surprisingly good pair, hm?)

0x00AD14.en: 「...You haven't changed a bit, Doctor Shirakawa.」

0x00AD60.en: 「A lot has happened, but here I am, as you see.」

0x00ADA0.en: 「I'd dearly love to hear, at length,@　just how you came back to life.」

0x00ADFC.en: 「Learn that, and you won't get off lightly.」

0x00AE2D.en: 「How dreadful.@　...So, what is it you want?」

0x00AE71.en: 「There's something I'd like your help with.」

0x00AEBA.en: 「My, my. And what's the catch, I wonder?」

0x00AEFD.en: 「A catch...@　I simply wish to do something about this situation myself.」

0x00AF5F.en: 「Then why not take your business elsewhere?@ To the Gaia Sabers, for instance.」

0x00AFD3.en: 「They're a valued client, after all...@　Shall I introduce you to Commander@　Alteur Steinbeck?」

0x00B063.en: 「There's a lot about him that raises suspicion.@ You think so too, don't you?」

0x00B0DA.en: 「He gives little thought to what comes after...@　no, perhaps he has no need to.@　That's where he differs from Lord Zezernan.」

0x00B1C2.en: 「Yes.@　And what I'm about to tell you concerns him as well.」

0x00B256.en: 「Kanan, however fond you may be@　of that girl...@　handing her the KoOhKi unit was ill-advised.」

0x00B2EF.en: 「Thanks to that, RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh@　both went and revived.」

0x00B345.en: 「It saved us the trouble of adjusting them ourselves, didn't it?」

0x00B382.en: 「The problem is how it happened.@　The shrine maiden helped bring about their revival.」

0x00B3EA.en: 「And the one who set that in motion was you...@　But you mustn't rush things.」

0x00B44C.en: 「But all the divine servants have appeared. Isn't it time?」

0x00B48F.en: 「No.@　Do you know how long it took to get this far?@　Rush the finish, and it could all be ruined.」

0x00B528.en: 「Let us wait a while longer.@　To make this promised land an eternal paradise...」
